column1: ## 🔴 WHAT IS STILL ABSENT, AND IT IS THE HALF THAT SELLS

# using GENERATIVE AI in general education, which p189 identified as the only Gulf instrument
# of that kind. So the Gulf closes on EXISTENCE and re-states on SUBSTANCE:
#   taught-about-AI : Saudi 🟢, UAE 🟢, Qatar 🟢, Bahrain 🟢   -> 4 of 4, CLOSED
#   AI-used-on-learners governed : Saudi 🟢, UAE 🔴, Qatar 🔴, Bahrain 🔴 -> 1 of 4
# 🔵 COMMERCIALLY this is the same inversion p189 found and it is now measured across all
# four states: in the Gulf the FUNDED line item is curriculum and teacher capability, and
# the REGULATED surface is largely ungoverned. An EMEA governance pitch does not transfer.
